dependency_install: Archived pyproject.toml.txt and uv.lock.txt fix Python dependencies for an isolated reconstruction. Core source snapshot is archived alongside them.
full_corpus_status: Requires original external inputs below; not a turnkey full-corpus experiment reproduction. Private inputs are not public dependencies.
held_input_hydration: hydrate.py --case CASE --ledger EXACT_ORIGINAL_COMPLETED_JSONL --out LOCAL_FILE; each case.provenance fixes the original ledger path and SHA256. Restores exact original prompt/answer only from lawfully available local evidence. Redistribution remains held.
live_rerun: Not authorized or implemented here. A separately authorized adopter-owned judge runner must send the exact recorded identity/rendered_input/options using its own credentials and write new outputs. No key is included, read, proxied or used.
missing_results: Missing original answers stay unknown; rerunning a model would create a new observation, not repair the historical record.
original_implementation: data/archived-code; .txt files are inert readable originals. Privacy comment replacements have both hashes in data/provenance.json. Original scripts can have import-time writes and absolute paths: never import them during replay.
portable_scope: Reparse public recorded Claude answers, preserve held numeric verdicts and unknowns, recompute reports from original admissions and aggregate paired arm counts/costs. No retrieval reconstruction.

resources.purpose: Original full public pools, rankings, campaign grouping and background bindings; selected campaign included in data/algorithm-input.json
novel-review-queue.jsonl, synthetic-arm-ledgers.jsonl, private-sidecar.jsonl (public blind roles), revised-rank-rows.jsonl in R2, source-proofs, split/funding manifests
frozen reviewed-pair exclusions; not an evaluated denominator
Private historical timelines, providers and source are intentionally unavailable publicly. Only sanitized final aggregates are included; they cannot be rerun from this kit.

source_acquisition: hydrate.py reads an existing local Git checkout/bare repository at exact revision:path and verifies full-file SHA256. No fetch or fuzzy substitution.
published_background_acquisition: python3 backgrounds.py --goldens /tmp/dry-lint-goldens --out /tmp/study-backgrounds; uses exact git objects at bb29c4b71987008d06c2381a68b6833b6d542e3e, never substitutes revision or scope.
